# Cavendish University Uganda

> > Cavendish University Uganda (CUU) is a private university in Kampala offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs across business, law, health sciences, technology, and humanities.

Located in Kyebando, Kampala, CUU is a leading private institution emphasizing career development, employability, and academic excellence. The university partners with organizations like BrighterMonday Uganda and Rotary Club, hosts distinguished lectures, and produces research through journals like the Cavendish Law Journal and Cavendish Journal of Social Sciences and Management.

## Academic Programs

- [Master of Public Health-Health Promotion](https://www.cavendish.ac.ug/master-of-public-health-health-promotion): MPH program focused on health promotion and behavior change
- [Bachelor of Environmental Health Science](https://www.cavendish.ac.ug/bachelor-of-environmental-health-science): Undergraduate degree in environmental health and disease prevention
- [Higher Education Certificate - Humanities](https://www.cavendish.ac.ug/higher-education-certificate-humanities): Foundation certificate program preparing students for undergraduate study
- [Faculty of Business and Management Video](https://www.cavendish.ac.ug/faculty-of-business-and-management-video): Video overview of Business and Management Faculty programs
